features.title: App dialogs for every plugin
features.summary: Provide the dshx Dialogs contract: confirm and alert open a plugin-ui alert dialog, prompt a dialog with one field, select a searchable grouped list; one request is open at a time and the rest wait in order.
failureModes: While this plugin is absent or disabled, dshx falls back to the browser's own confirm, alert and prompt dialogs.
Disposing the plugin answers every open and waiting request as cancelled, so no caller waits forever.

verification.testName: resolves true from the confirm button
ignores an empty submit and resolves the typed value
groups options, marks the current one and resolves the picked value
opens one request at a time, in arrival order
makes Dialogs and Toasts active while mounted and withdraws them on dispose

telemetry.reason: Client-only: App dialogs for every plugin renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: App toasts for every plugin
features.summary: Provide the dshx Toasts contract: a bottom-right stack with tone colors, an optional action, auto-dismiss after the duration (5 s by default, 0 keeps it) and a dismiss function.
failureModes: While this plugin is absent or disabled, dshx logs each toast to the console instead.

verification.testName: closes on its own after the default 5 s
dismisses through the returned function and the close button
